(enoxolone) Profile Enoxolone aluminium is an analogue of carbenoxolone (p.1714) that has been used in preparations for the treatment of peptic ul- cer disease and other gastrointestinal disorders. It has also been used in preparations for skin disorders and mouth and throat dis- orders. Primary pulmonary hypertension. In-utero exposure to enoxolone was implicated in a fatal case of neonatal primary pul- monary hypertension; the mother had used a lotion for prurigo that contained enoxolone and the authors supposed it had con- tributed at least in part to the pulmonary hypertension.1 1.
